subject: a blank book whose spine becomes a short living branch
pose: pages opening in a shallow fan
art_direction: 一本无字书的书脊长成短枝，纸页像叶片展开，绿金配色清楚温柔。
visible_description: 一本无字绿皮书的书脊化为短树枝，一片新叶伸向旁侧，金黄背景衬出紧凑超现实静物。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a blank book whose spine becomes a short living branch. The branch forms the lower support, with only two small leaves emerging near the spine. Keep the pages thick, blank, and slightly uneven, catching warm light along their edges. The cover is muted green without symbols. Use a pale golden background and a centered three-quarter view, avoiding a full tree or scattered paper. Use paper-and-wood surreal illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
